question: Who is the writer of the famous autobiography ‘The Story of My Life’ ?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Helen Keller**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Helen Keller** was an American author, disability rights advocate, political activist, and lecturer.
 
• Her autobiography, **'The Story of My Life'**, was published in **1903**.
 
• The book provides a detailed account of her **life struggles and achievements**, particularly after losing her sight and hearing</s
